# Calculate positions for L-shaped configuration
# Two square plates: 140x140x10mm each
plate_size = 140  # mm
plate_thickness = 10  # mm
cutout_size = 45  # mm

# First plate (horizontal): lies flat on XY plane
plate1_x_pos = 0
plate1_y_pos = 0
plate1_z_pos = 0
plate1_x_size = plate_size
plate1_y_size = plate_size
plate1_z_size = plate_thickness

# Second plate (vertical): stands perpendicular to first plate
# It should share one edge with the first plate to form an L-shape
# Position it at the edge of the first plate
plate2_x_pos = 0
plate2_y_pos = plate_size - plate_thickness  # Position at the far edge minus thickness
plate2_z_pos = 0
plate2_x_size = plate_size
plate2_y_size = plate_thickness
plate2_z_size = plate_size

# Cutout position (centered on first plate)
# Center of cutout should be at center of plate1
cutout_center_x = plate_size / 2
cutout_center_y = plate_size / 2
# Cutout basepoint (bottom-left corner)
cutout_x_pos = cutout_center_x - cutout_size / 2
cutout_y_pos = cutout_center_y - cutout_size / 2
cutout_z_pos = 0
cutout_x_size = cutout_size
cutout_y_size = cutout_size
cutout_z_size = plate_thickness

print(f"Plate 1 (horizontal): pos=({plate1_x_pos}, {plate1_y_pos}, {plate1_z_pos}), size=({plate1_x_size}, {plate1_y_size}, {plate1_z_size})")
print(f"Plate 2 (vertical): pos=({plate2_x_pos}, {plate2_y_pos}, {plate2_z_pos}), size=({plate2_x_size}, {plate2_y_size}, {plate2_z_size})")
print(f"Cutout: pos=({cutout_x_pos}, {cutout_y_pos}, {cutout_z_pos}), size=({cutout_x_size}, {cutout_y_size}, {cutout_z_size})")
